title: DevOps & Deployment Pipelines - Quiz
description: Test your understanding of DevOps and deployment pipeline concepts in PEGA

questions.question: What is the primary benefit of CI/CD pipelines in PEGA applications?
options: Automated software delivery from code commit to production
questions.explanation: CI/CD pipelines provide automated software delivery from code commit to production deployment, ensuring consistent, reliable, and rapid application delivery.

questions.question: Which testing approach is most comprehensive for automated pipelines?
options: Multi-layer testing including unit, integration, and end-to-end tests
questions.explanation: Comprehensive automated testing includes unit tests, integration tests, end-to-end tests, and performance tests to ensure quality across all application layers.

questions.question: How should deployment environments be configured?
options: Multiple environments (dev, test, staging, production) with appropriate configurations
questions.explanation: Multiple deployment environments (development, testing, staging, production) should be configured with appropriate settings, data, and security configurations for each stage.

questions.question: What is crucial for secrets management in CI/CD?
options: Encrypted secrets management with environment-specific access controls
questions.explanation: Secrets management requires encrypted storage with environment-specific access controls, proper key rotation, and secure distribution mechanisms to protect sensitive data.

questions.question: How should deployment failures be handled?
options: Through automated rollback mechanisms and immediate alerting
questions.explanation: Deployment failures should trigger automated rollback mechanisms, immediate alerting, and comprehensive logging to ensure rapid recovery and minimize business impact.

questions.question: What is the purpose of blue-green deployment strategy?
options: To achieve zero-downtime deployments with instant rollback capability
questions.explanation: Blue-green deployment strategy enables zero-downtime deployments by maintaining two identical production environments, allowing instant rollback if issues arise.

questions.question: How should monitoring be implemented in production?
options: Comprehensive monitoring with real-time dashboards, alerting, and performance metrics
questions.explanation: Production monitoring requires comprehensive real-time dashboards, automated alerting, performance metrics, and observability tools to ensure application health and performance.

questions.question: What is essential for configuration management?
options: Environment-specific configuration files with version control and validation
questions.explanation: Configuration management requires environment-specific configuration files under version control with proper validation, testing, and deployment automation.
